# wpaudit.pro

> Free WordPress site health audits by Chris Smith (Technical SEO & Web Engineer).
> Instant scores for performance, SEO, AEO/GEO, security, technical health, and accessibility.
> Multi-page crawl (up to 10 URLs). Optional PDF report via email. No login required.

## Primary pages

- Home / audit entry: https://wpaudit.pro/
- Run audit: https://wpaudit.pro/audit
- How it works: https://wpaudit.pro/how-it-works
- FAQ: https://wpaudit.pro/faq

## Product facts

- Turnaround: typically under 60 seconds
- Price: free automated scan; paid implementation available via Chris Smith
- Author: Chris Smith — Technical SEO · Web Engineer (Australia, remote worldwide)
- Marketing / implementation: https://lightsalmon-bison-476856.hostingersite.com/
